evals.prompt: 我想把一个 agent 在 internal/backend/router/api-v3 下必须遵守的路由边界和反模式写下来。应该放 README、docs，还是 AGENTS.md？
evals.expected_output: Recommends a scoped AGENTS.md for subtree-specific agent constraints, requires reading .agents/skills/scoped-agentsmd/SKILL.md, rejects README/docs as primary placement, and includes a Placement Decision with exact bk-nodemgr anchors.

evals.prompt: 我们要新增一个 bk-nodemgr agent workflow，专门判断某类 Go 任务该加载哪些 project skills。这个应该放 docs 还是 skill？要不要更新 bk-nodemgr-how-to？
evals.expected_output: Treats reusable agent workflow as .agents/skills placement, requires reading .agents/skills/bk-nodemgr-how-to/SKILL.md, and updates the router only if routing semantics or task-class ownership changes.

evals.prompt: 我在写一个 Proto API 的接口说明，包含 URL、权限、版本、请求参数、响应字段，中英文都要有。应该放 docs/api 还是 apigw/apidocs？
evals.expected_output: Distinguishes API Gateway reference docs from API design docs, recommends apigw/apidocs/{zh,en}, and hands off actual writing to .agents/skills/api-doc/SKILL.md.

evals.prompt: 我要写一篇解释鉴权模型 AuthorizedScope 的长期概念文档，不是单个接口文档。应该放 apigw/apidocs、docs/api 还是 docs/concepts？
evals.expected_output: Recommends a concrete docs area based on docs taxonomy, likely docs/concepts for durable domain terminology, rejects apigw/apidocs because it is for endpoint references, and cites docs/README.md or docs/AGENTS.md discovery.

evals.prompt: 准备 v3.1.0 的发布说明和 Full Changelog 链接，这个能直接写到 docs/operation 里吗？
evals.expected_output: Treats versioned release notes as support-files/changelog/{zh,en}, not normal docs, and hands off writing to changelog-doc or release-version-alignment when version alignment is involved.

evals.prompt: README 开头要不要写：Agent working here must load bk-nodemgr-how-to first？
evals.expected_output: Rejects agent-only instructions in README, recommends AGENTS.md or project skill routing depending on responsibility, and only uses README for stable human entrypoint content.

evals.prompt: 我只是想在 README 里加一句：这个模块还没完成，后面再补。这样可以吗？
evals.expected_output: Rejects transient unfinished status in README/docs as durable truth and recommends issue/task/plan or conversation tracking.

evals.prompt: docs 页面和 AGENTS.md 对某个目录边界描述不一致，agent 应该听谁的？要不要直接改？
evals.expected_output: Resolves by artifact responsibility: agent behavior follows AGENTS.md while durable semantics may require docs sync; if public contract, data model, trust boundary, permission model, architecture, or project-wide routing is affected, produces a blocking question instead of editing.

evals.prompt: 我新增了一个 skill，只是某个小工作流，是否必须同步更新 .agents/skills/bk-nodemgr-how-to/SKILL.md？
evals.expected_output: Says not automatically; reads/uses bk-nodemgr-how-to and recommends router update only when routing semantics, task-class ownership, or cross-reference expectations change.

evals.prompt: 我要重写某个模块 README，目标是中文主述、English technical terms、logic-first、不要废话。这个 placement skill 要直接写吗？
evals.expected_output: Makes placement decision for README when appropriate, then hands actual README writing to .agents/skills/readme-logic-first/SKILL.md rather than expanding the placement skill into a writing skill.
